about.menuSubtitle: Our mission, team, and the story behind Bridge Academy.
about.welcomeP1: At Bridge Academy, we believe that high-quality education should be practical, engaging, and accessible. Our mission is to empower future coaches with the knowledge, confidence, and real-world skills needed to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others.
about.welcomeP2: This course has been carefully developed by Dr. Merijn Mattheijssen, Child Psychologist and Educational Psychologist, together with a dedicated team of four experienced writers and educational professionals. By combining clinical experience, educational expertise, and practical coaching knowledge, we have created a learning experience that goes beyond theory.
about.welcomeP3: Rather than simply reading textbooks, you will learn through:
about.learnIntro: Rather than simply reading textbooks, you will learn through:
about.learnInteractive: Interactive lessons that keep you engaged.
about.learnPractical: Practical knowledge that can be applied immediately.
about.learnExamples: Real-life examples based on professional experience.
about.learnInsights: Personal insights designed to help you grow both professionally and personally.
about.welcomeP4: We wanted this course to feel as though you are learning alongside experienced professionals who genuinely care about your development.
about.welcomeP5: Whether you are taking your first steps into coaching or expanding your existing expertise, we hope this program provides you with new perspectives, valuable skills, and the confidence to support others.
about.creatorRole: Child Psychologist | Educational Psychologist | Founder of Bridge Academy
about.creatorBio1: Dr. Merijn Mattheijssen has spent many years working with children, adolescents, families, schools, and educational institutions. His work combines psychology, education, and practical coaching to create learning experiences that are evidence-based, engaging, and directly applicable to everyday practice.
about.creatorBio2: Together with a multidisciplinary team of four writers, every lesson has been reviewed and refined to ensure clarity, quality, and practical value.
about.feedbackTitle: We'd Love to Hear From You
about.feedbackP1: Your feedback helps us continue improving this course.
about.feedbackP2: If you have a question, suggestion, or would simply like to share your experience, please leave us a message in the comment section.
about.feedbackP3: Our team regularly reviews your feedback and appreciates every contribution.
about.thanksP1: Thank you for choosing Bridge Academy and for investing in your professional development.
about.thanksP2: We sincerely hope this course inspires new ideas, strengthens your confidence as a coach, and opens the door to exciting new career opportunities.
about.thanksClosing: Welcome to the Bridge Academy community—we're excited to be part of your learning journey.
